Strategy
A fund of funds that invests its assets in international equity and fixed income funds. The investor has access to both the professionalism of the portfolio managers of single investment funds and the choice between different investment funds and markets made by a professional. The investor also gets to utilise funds directed at institutional investors. The fund is suitable for investors with moderate risk-taking ability who want to be involved in the international equity and interest markets. The recommended investment period is at least three to five years.
